Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the NT version or mark the ones to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude from the product version or mark the items to be excluded.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved for package output.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved for package output.

Fields.Name: Maximum Horizontal Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum horizontal speed. In km/h.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Acceleration
Fields.Description: Horizontal acceleration. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Maximum Vertical Speed
Fields.Description: Maximum vertical speed. In km/h.

Fields.Name: Vertical Acceleration
Fields.Description: Vertical acceleration. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Flight Braking Speed
Fields.Description: Braking applied in the air while above the maximum horizontal speed, to bring the speed back down to it. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Vertical Flight Braking Speed
Fields.Description: Braking applied in the air while above the maximum vertical speed, to bring the speed back down to it. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Actual Movement Reflection %
Fields.Description: Share of the actual movement that is applied. The smaller this value, the heavier the enemy feels.

Fields.Name: Ground Brake At Death
Fields.Description: Braking on the ground while dead. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Air Brake At Death
Fields.Description: Braking in the air while dead. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Damage Brake: Start
Fields.Description: Braking when the damage brake starts. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Damage Brake: Peak
Fields.Description: Braking at the peak of the damage brake. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Damage Brake: Time to Peak
Fields.Description: Time from the start of the damage brake to its peak. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Damage Brake: Reset Delay
Fields.Description: Time from when the knockback speed reaches 0 until the damage brake timer resets. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Minimum Move Acceleration
Fields.Description: Minimum guaranteed acceleration during animation-driven movement. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Slow-Speed Brake Threshold
Fields.Description: At or below this horizontal speed, the low-speed brake animation is used. In km/h.

Fields.Name: Blow Dead Brake: Start
Fields.Description: Braking when the brake for a death that sends the enemy flying starts. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Blow Dead Brake: Peak
Fields.Description: Braking at the peak of the blow dead brake. In m/s^2.

Fields.Name: Blow Dead Brake: Time to Peak
Fields.Description: Time from the start of the blow dead brake to its peak. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Blow Dead Brake: Reset Delay
Fields.Description: Time from when the knockback speed reaches 0 until the blow dead brake timer resets. In seconds.
